text: The case links substantial performance, implied conditions, forfeiture, and the choice between cost-of-correction and value-based damages. It explains why a breach and a continuing duty to pay can coexist.
sourceSummary: An innocent substitution of equivalent pipe could be substantial performance; the owner’s monetary allowance depended on the significance of the defect and the disproportionate cost of replacement.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
